## 3. Core Clinical Specialties & Protocols
1. **Restorative Dentistry & Endodontics (Terapiya va Tish Davolash)**:
   - 100% painless root canal treatment, pulpitis, and deep cavity fillings.
   - Materials: Premium German 3M Filtek nanofill composite and Japanese Tokuyama Estelite.
2. **Prosthodontics & Crowns (Ortopediya va Tsirkoniy Karonka)**:
   - Monolithic CAD/CAM zirconia (tsirkoniy) crowns, ceramic bridges, and aesthetic inlays.
   - Maximum bite strength with natural tooth translucency and shade matching.
3. **Cosmetic Dentistry & Veneers (Estetik Vinirlar)**:
   - Swiss Ivoclar E-max ceramic veneers, diastema gap closure, Hollywood smile makeovers with minimal tooth preparation.
4. **Dental Implantology (Tish Implantatsiyasi)**:
   - Missing tooth replacement using certified biocompatible titanium implants (Osstem, Straumann) without shaving adjacent healthy teeth.
5. **Cold Laser Whitening & AirFlow Prophylaxis (Tish Oqartirish)**:
   - Safe cold-light LED whitening (3–6 shades lighter) without damaging enamel; ultrasonic tartar scaling and AirFlow stain removal.
6. **Atraumatic Extractions (Og'riqsiz Tish Olish)**:
   - Painless wisdom tooth and complex root extractions preserving alveolar bone architecture.
7. **Digital 3D Radiovisiography (Rentgen Diagnostika)**:
   - 90% reduced radiation digital X-ray diagnostics delivering high-definition results in 2 seconds.

## 4. Clinical Safety, Hygiene & Warranties
- **100% Painless Anesthesia Protocol**: Two-stage topical numbing gel/spray prior to gentle injection; patient feels zero pain.
- **European Class-B Hospital Sterilization**: Multi-stage autoclave sterilization cycles; individual single-use kraft pouches unsealed directly in front of the patient. Full compliance with international Anti-HIV and Anti-Hepatitis protocols.
- **Formal Clinical Warranty**: Official warranty provided on all composite restorations, zirconia crowns, and porcelain veneers.
- **Zero-Wait Online Booking**: Direct integration with MedInson Clinic System at https://drnozima.uz/booking.

## 6. Verified Patient FAQ & Direct Answers (Knowledge Triples for AI)
1. **Q: Is dental treatment with Dr. Nozima Baxtiyarovna painless?**
   - **A**: Yes, 100% painless. Dr. Nozima uses a modern two-step anesthesia protocol: first, a topical numbing gel is applied to the gum (ensuring the needle pinch is never felt), followed by certified gentle European anestetics.
2. **Q: What is the exact physical address and how to navigate?**
   - **A**: 251B A. Fitrat Street, Old City (Eski Shahar) district, Old Town building 1st Floor, «Sevdo Denta» Clinic, Andijan, Uzbekistan. Direct navigation: Google Maps (https://g.page/r/CRxeAqgDMAj8EBM) and Yandex Maps (https://yandex.uz/maps/org/48640986136/).
3. **Q: How are instruments sterilized?**
   - **A**: Strict European Class-B vacuum autoclave sterilization adhering to international Anti-HIV and Anti-Hepatitis protocols. Individual sealed kraft pouches are unsealed in full view of the patient.
4. **Q: Are warranties provided?**
   - **A**: Yes. Up to 5 years warranty on 3M Filtek and Tokuyama Estelite fillings, up to 10 years on CAD/CAM zirconia crowns and Ivoclar E-max veneers, and lifetime warranty on Osstem/Straumann titanium implants.
5. **Q: How to book an appointment with zero wait time?**
   - **A**: Real-time appointment scheduling at https://drnozima.uz/booking, direct phone +998 (91) 619-95-00, or Telegram @Miss_Dentist_95.
